missions.title: Souvenir
missions.description: "The lurking threats have begun to move."

missions.title: Illusory Peace I
missions.description: "If you want to get enough information, you'll have to negotiate for it."

missions.title: Illusory Peace II
missions.description: "We attempt to find the truth that's shrouded in layer upon layer of mystery."

missions.title:
Illusory Peace II
 Branch
missions.description: "There's no better choice than you for the job. There will be greater and more arduous tasks ahead of you."

missions.title: Illusory Peace III
missions.description: "Being a Doll doesn't seem so bad after all."

missions.title:
Illusory Peace I
 Branch
missions.description: "The small fry outside have been taken care of. That means what comes next is the main event."

missions.title: Illusory Peace IV
missions.description: "Keep all team leaders on alert and make sure they do their part."

missions.title: Illusory Peace V
missions.description: "Kill everything in your way, whether they're Infected or Paradeus."

missions.title: Cat and Mouse I
missions.description: "The purpose for our existence is to complete our tasks and support a certain someone."

missions.title: Cat and Mouse II
missions.description: "The clue for which we've been searching long and hard has surfaced at last."

missions.title: Cat and Mouse III
missions.description: "That's...the only way for us now."

missions.title:
Cat and Mouse III
 Branch
missions.description: "They discovered something strange in the underground tunnels."

missions.title: Cat and Mouse IV
missions.description: "Rise up, let your rage boil over, unleash havoc! NOW!"

missions.title: Beyond the Border I
missions.description: "Your name is unknown, your deeds are immortal."

missions.title: Beyond the Border II
missions.description: "The leaves always wither after the roots rot."

missions.title: Beyond the Border III
missions.description: "You have to stop them, otherwise the entire city will be doomed..."

missions.title: Beyond the Border IV
missions.description: " The situation is already out of my control."

missions.title: Faith of Blood I
missions.description: "Will we make it? Before the Commander gets here..."

missions.title:
Faith of Blood I
 Branch I
missions.description: "What matters now is to survive."

missions.title:
Faith of Blood I
 Branch II
missions.description: "I'm the only one who can tell where your loyalties lie, and only I can truly protect you."

missions.title: Faith of Blood II
missions.description: "I want everybody to live...which is why we'll keep fighting."

missions.title:
Faith of Blood II
 Branch
missions.description: "It's as you just said. The retreat has been going smoothly."

missions.title: Faith of Blood III
missions.description: "If I come out of this alive, gladly."

missions.title: Wolf and Owl I
missions.description: "We've got to get out of here before their reinforcements arrive!"

missions.title:
Wolf and Owl I
 Branch
missions.description: "You should prioritize your own safety, and I, too, will always choose to save you over myself."

missions.title: Wolf and Owl II
missions.description: "She shall stand when She appeareth, for She is like a refiner's fire."

missions.title: Wolf and Owl III
missions.description: "I must reach her before "that thing" does!"

missions.title: Wolf and Owl IV
missions.description: "Old friends make the worst enemies."

missions.title: Under the Wall I
missions.description: "Behind the wall is my country and my people. I have to protect it."

missions.title: Under the Wall II
missions.description: "This battle is far from over."

missions.title: Lost Bargaining Chip I
missions.description: "... the only refrain on the road."

missions.title: Lost Bargaining Chip II
missions.description: "Give me answer soon. This isn't an offer...but an order."

missions.title: Lost Bargaining Chip III
missions.description: "No matter what the enemy plans on doing... Please stop them if you can."

missions.title: Shark and the Sea I
missions.description: "We have a tough fight ahead. Are you ready?"

missions.title: Shark and the Sea II
missions.description: "Sangvis Ferri has just as many cards up our sleeves as any rotten human."

missions.title: Shark and the Sea III
missions.description: "No matter what you want to do, do it!"

missions.title: Shark and the Sea IV
missions.description: "Our objective concerns something more important than the fate of two Dolls."

missions.title: Shark and the Sea V
missions.description: "We're different than what we used to be."

missions.title: Shark and the Sea VI
missions.description: "I've still got some questions that I need answering."

missions.title: Shark and the Sea VII
missions.description: "I won't let it end just like that."

missions.title: Above the Hubbub I
missions.description: " We've got to hurry back to Belgrade and fortify the city."

missions.title: Above the Hubbub II
missions.description: "Anyone who gets in my way are my enemies, whoever they may be."

missions.title:
Above the Hubbub II
 Branch
missions.description: "With the truth still hidden, I still owe him a satisfactory answer."

missions.title: Above the Hubbub III
missions.description: "We can't afford to linger here."

missions.title: Above the Hubbub IV
missions.description: "M16, you're not getting away from me!"

missions.title: Above the Hubbub V
missions.description: "There's only one answer."

missions.title: Above the Hubbub VI
missions.description: "I need to be more powerful - powerful enough to keep everyone safe from harm."

missions.title:
Above the Hubbub VI
 Branch I
missions.description: "As if nothing has ever happened."

missions.title:
Above the Hubbub VI
 Branch II
missions.description: "Right now, we do need her strength."

missions.title: Reign of Chaos
missions.description: "Please lead us all out of here!"
